# Staff Software Engineer, Platform — Northpine Logistics (fictional)

Northpine Logistics routes freight across North America. Toronto, hybrid (Tuesday to Thursday in the office).

## Must have

- 10+ years of software engineering, with 3+ years as a tech lead.
- Java or Kotlin on the JVM.
- Designing distributed systems at scale.
- Apache Kafka.
- Mentoring and growing senior engineers.

## Should have

- Experience with GCP.
- Knowledge of the logistics or supply-chain domain.

We support relocation to Toronto from elsewhere in Canada.
